prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `CaseData`, `CasePanel`, and `buildCasePanel`.

`CaseData` has readonly fields `title`, `bannerUrl`, `customer`, `category`, and `completedOn` of type string, plus `paragraphs` and `attachments` of type `readonly string[]`.

`CasePanel` has readonly fields `heading`, `bannerUrl`, `customer`, and `completedOn`; `categoryLink` containing `{ label: string; href: "#"; preventsNavigation: true }`; and `paragraphs` and `attachments` as readonly string arrays.

`buildCasePanel(data: CaseData, visible: boolean): CasePanel | null` returns `null` when not visible. When visible, every scalar field and every paragraph or attachment URL must be non-empty after trimming; otherwise throw `RangeError`. Preserve paragraph and attachment order and values exactly. The result's two arrays must be fresh copies so later mutation of caller-owned arrays cannot affect it. The function must not mutate its input.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
